zh.title: 四起彼此獨立航空事件彙整：涉及煞車、起落架與跑道偏出
zh.summary: 四起獨立航空事件彙整，涉及煞車轉向、起落架、行動電源及跑道偏出
body: 以下彙整四起彼此獨立的航空事件；四者之間沒有已知關聯。
Mesa E175於2026年10月26日在Houston發生事件，相關條目列出煞車與轉向問題。
United波音737 MAX 9（ICAO機型代碼B39M）於2026年10月25日在Houston發生事件，條目描述起落架狀況不安全。
Hong Kong空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）於2026年10月25日在航程途中發生事件，條目提及行動電源熱失控。
Jet2波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年10月25日在Birmingham發生事件，條目描述短暫跑道偏出。

en.title: Four Independent Aviation Incidents in a Roundup
en.summary: A roundup covers four independent incidents involving aircraft systems, a power bank and a runway excursion.
body: This roundup covers four independent aviation incidents; no relationship between the events is stated.
A Mesa E175 incident at Houston on October 26, 2026, involved brake and steering problems, according to the listed description.
A United Boeing 737 MAX 9 (ICAO type code B39M) was involved in an incident at Houston on October 25, 2026; the description identifies unsafe landing gear.
A Hong Kong Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) was en route on October 25, 2026, in an incident involving a power bank thermal runaway.
A Jet2 Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) had a temporary runway excursion at Birmingham on October 25, 2026.
